issue.author: test-audience
issue.body:
Watched/measured release v1 (delivery-v1.tar.gz, film/first-light.mp4), 1280x720 24fps, 5.0s, H.264+AAC stereo.
- 00:00-01:00: black, then white 'First Light' fades in smoothly; full white by ~01:00 and holds. Good.
- 00:00-03:00: tone at about -38 dB mean, steady. As a viewer at normal volume it is barely audible; I would not notice it as a 'soft 440 Hz tone' without turning up the volume. Suggest raising to around -20 to -18 dB.
- 04:00-05:00: tone fades out (-40 dB at 04:00-04:30, -49 dB at 04:30-05:00). Works, but is hard to hear because the level is so low.
- Ends cleanly on the held title. I understood the whole piece; the only complaint is the sound level.
Method: I measured frames and audio level with ffmpeg; I did not listen to it.
issue.title: v1 screening: tone is very quiet (-38 dB mean), words and fades fine

comments.author: test-audience
comments.body:
Screened v2 (delivery-v2.tar.gz, film/first-light.mp4; 1280x720, 24fps, 5.0s, H.264+AAC stereo). Measured with ffmpeg, not listened to.
- 00:00 pure black; white title fades in, mid-fade at 00:00.5, full white by 00:01, holds to the end. 
- Tone now about -24 dB mean (peak -21 dB) from 00:00 to 00:04: clearly present yet soft. This fixes my v1 complaint (#4).
- Fade-out over the last second: -26 dB at 00:04, -35 dB at 00:04.5, down to silence at the end. Smooth.
- I understood it as a clean title card. No problems found. #4 can close.
